name: Huis met de Hoofden

surveyed.source: Vertex average of the BAG 0363100012177213 ring (PDOK BAG WFS, CC0) as the anchor; local east/south metres at 111320 m per degree (cos-latitude in longitude). The builder's facade frame runs along the BAG front from its north corner (bearing 210, front facing 300); part heights from the 3DBAG LoD2.2 roof planes (CC BY 4.0, ground 0.854 m NAP); facade heights measured on the RCE photograph 20408929 (CC BY-SA 4.0) scaled to the 13.87 m BAG front of the main house. See huis-met-de-hoofden-footprints.json.

attribution.title: Huis met de Hoofden, Keizersgracht 123
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG heights (CC BY 4.0): the 1622 Amsterdam Renaissance canal front with its six sandstone busts (Apollo, Ceres, Mercury, Minerva, Bacchus, Diana), cross windows under relieving arches, sandstone bands and blocks, festoons, door portal on a double stoop, balustrades, three-stage stepped gable with volutes, obelisks, niches, columns, broken pediment and ball finial, and the gateway wing; read from the RCE photographs 20408929 and 20018060 (Sergé Technau, CC BY-SA 4.0), Wikimedia Commons photographs by Samuel Mudrík (CC BY-SA 4.0) and Michele Ahin (CC BY-SA 3.0 nl), and Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0), for proportion only. No photo pixels or imported meshes.

partyWallNote: The north side (bearing 30) adjoins Keizersgracht 119-121 (pand 0363100012167694) and the south side (bearing 210) Keizersgracht 125-127 (pand 0363100012165029): both BAG rings share these walls.
